explanation: Requested a 3x3 grid for the eta channel (e p -> e' p eta): W in {1.55, 1.65, 1.75} GeV, Q2 in {0.5, 1.0, 1.5} GeV^2, all 9 points at cos(theta*)=0, phi*=90 deg. All 9 combinations are above the eta+p production threshold (W_thr ~ 1.4861 GeV), Q2 is positive and within the lookup table coverage, cos(theta*)=0 is nowhere near the +/-1 integration poles that are known to hang this channel, and phi=90 deg is a normal value. The exclurad_preflight_check tool returned PASS for all 9 points with no warnings. No corrections were necessary; the grid was written as a single EXCLURAD input file (9 points fit under the 10-point-per-file chunking convention) using the default beam energy (6.53 GeV) and default vcut (0.166 GeV^2) for the eta channel.
